title: 无损耗线的输入阻抗：阻抗被“转”了
statement: 50 Ω 无损耗线长 l = 0.6 m，相速 v = 2×10⁸ m/s，频率 50 MHz。终端负载 Z_L = (100 + j50) Ω；始端接 U̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值）、内阻 R_s = 50 Ω。
输入阻抗 Z_in 指从始端 1–1′ 向终端看进去的阻抗（连同负载）。x 从始端量起。

questions.ask: 从 1–1′ 看进去的输入阻抗 Z_in 的实部 = ?

questions.explain: 虚部为负：从始端看进去呈容性，虽然负载本身是感性的——传输线把阻抗“转”了。

questions.ask: 负载吸收的平均功率 P_L = ?
questions.explain: 无损耗线不消耗功率：P_L = P_1 = I_1²·Re Z_in = 0.1033² × 37.50 = 0.4 W。另一条路：电源匹配，可用功率 U_s²/(4R_s) = 0.5 W，反射掉 |Γ_2|² = 0.2，所以负载得到 0.5 × (1 − 0.2) = 0.4 W。

questions.ask: 如果把线长改成 λ/2 = 2 m（其他不变），输入阻抗会是多少？
choiceExplain: 这是 λ/4 线（tan βl → ∞）的结果。
只有负载匹配时 Z_in 才等于 Z_c。
questions.explain: tan(βl) = tan π = 0，代入公式 Z_in = Z_L：半波长线把负载阻抗原样“搬”到始端（每隔 λ/2 重复一次）。

hints: 无损耗线的输入阻抗公式：Z_in = Z_c·(Z_L + jZ_c tan βl)/(Z_c + jZ_L tan βl)。它由终端的 U̇_2、İ_2 用 cos/sin 形式的线方程推出。
求出 Z_in 后，始端就是一个普通的集总电路：İ_1 = U̇_s/(R_s + Z_in)；无损耗线上功率守恒。

en.title: Input impedance of a lossless line: the impedance is transformed
statement: A 50 Ω lossless line is l = 0.6 m long, with phase velocity v = 2×10⁸ m/s, at 50 MHz. The load is Z_L = (100 + j50) Ω; the start is driven by U̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms) with internal resistance R_s = 50 Ω.
The input impedance Z_in is the impedance seen at the start 1–1′ looking towards the end (load included). x is measured from the start.

questions.ask: Real part of the input impedance Z_in seen at 1–1′ = ?

questions.explain: Negative: the input looks capacitive although the load itself is inductive — the line transforms the impedance.

questions.ask: rms current at the start I_1 = ?
Average power absorbed by the load P_L = ?
questions.explain: A lossless line absorbs nothing: P_L = P_1 = I_1²·Re Z_in = 0.1033² × 37.50 = 0.4 W. Another route: the source is matched, its available power is U_s²/(4R_s) = 0.5 W, a fraction |Γ_2|² = 0.2 is reflected, so the load gets 0.5 × (1 − 0.2) = 0.4 W.

questions.ask: If the line were λ/2 = 2 m long (all else equal), what would the input impedance be?
questions.explain: tan(βl) = tan π = 0, so the formula gives Z_in = Z_L: a half-wave line copies the load impedance to its input (it repeats every λ/2).
choiceExplain: That is the λ/4 line (tan βl → ∞).
Z_in = Z_c only for a matched load.

hints: First the electrical length βl = 2πl/λ with λ = v/f.
Input impedance of a lossless line: Z_in = Z_c·(Z_L + jZ_c tan βl)/(Z_c + jZ_L tan βl), obtained from the cos/sin form of the line equations with the end values U̇_2, İ_2.
Once Z_in is known the start is an ordinary lumped circuit: İ_1 = U̇_s/(R_s + Z_in); power is conserved along a lossless line.
solution: **1. Electrical length.** λ = 2×10⁸/5×10⁷ = 4 m, l = 0.15λ, βl = 54°, tan βl = 1.376.
